🔥 NEW: MERCURY, THE LOST KEEPER! 🔥

An alien ship, a dark ring base, a secret castle under the crater!
🚀 Build a rocket and explore the Moon, Mars, Venus, Mercury... and Mars 4 billion years ago!
☀️ MERCURY STORY – help Vega, outsmart BOLT, wake the REACTOR
⛏️ THE MINE – ride carts 4 levels deep, mine 12 ores
🏰 KEEPER'S HOLLOW – a floating castle in a glowing cave
💎 CRYSTAL ROOKIE – a rolling, colour-changing skin
🛠️ BUILD – upgrade your rocket to level 30
⭐ RANK – earn XP, unlock 27 skills
🌕 MOON · 🔴 MARS · ☁️ VENUS · 🌋 OLYMPUS – stations, rovers & rune puzzles
🔒 SECRETS – bunkers, teleporters, a man in the lift...
🎮 MINIGAMES – Docking, Fuel Mixer, ROCKET RUN & more

🤖 ROOKIE · 📜 JOBS · 📅 DAILY · 👥 FRIENDS

💎 VIP, 2x Coins Forever, Builder's Pass, Jet Pro & Starter Pack

🎉 1K PLAYERS! Code 1kCCU = free Crystal Rookie

👍 Like & ⭐ favourite for updates!
